message.content:
The **United States Declaration of Independence** was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies. Here’s a list of all the signers:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, Thomas McKean |
| **Pennsylvania** | Robert Morris, Benjamin Rush, Benjamin Franklin, John Morton, George Clymer, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Ross |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Witherspoon, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Abraham Clark |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Adams, John Hancock (again), John Hancock (again) – *Note: John Hancock is listed once; the others are distinct individuals* |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll of Carrollton, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll of Carrollton (again) – *Note: Charles Carroll appears twice in the original list but is counted once* |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison, George Wythe, James Monroe, John Tyler, James Madison, William H. Crawford, William Fitzhugh, William Nelson, William H. Cabell, William H. Cabell (again) – *Note: Some names appear multiple times in the original list but are counted once* |
| **New York** | Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, John Jay |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Samuel J. Potter |

> **Key Signers**  
> - **Thomas Jefferson** – Principal author of the Declaration.  
> - **John Adams** – Strong advocate for independence.  
> - **Benjamin Franklin** – Renowned statesman and diplomat.  
> - **John Hancock** – His bold signature became synonymous with the act of signing.

These individuals represented their colonies and collectively formalized the United States' break from British rule on **July 4, 1776**.
